transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I... well, I suppose I'm here because I just keep hearing people talking about me. At the office, mostly. 

Like, through the conference room walls. Or from my phone, even when it's completely turned off. It's usually the board members, or some of the staff. They keep saying I'm... ruining the company. It's just... it sounds so clear. I actually catch myself answering them back before I realize... before I realize no one else heard it.
Have you been feeling depressed or down lately?
I don't... no. I wouldn't say that. I'm just trying to focus on my job right now. I don't think I'm depressed.
Have you noticed that your work or daily functioning has gotten worse because of these experiences?

I... well, I suppose things have slipped a bit. 

At the office, I just... I can't really make the decisions I need to anymore. The senior staff, they've started handling things I used to do. Quietly, mostly. And at home... my husband is doing almost everything now. I just... I start things and don't finish them. Or I don't start them at all. It's just hard to focus.
Have you been having any periods of feeling unusually elevated, energetic, or needing much less sleep than usual?
No... I don't think so. I sleep fine. I definitely haven't felt energetic.
Have you had any recent head injury, illness, or new medical problem before these symptoms started?
No... nothing like that. I haven't been sick or... hurt my head. Physically, I'm fine.
How long have you been hearing these voices?
I... guess it's been about three months. Roughly. That's when I first started noticing them... coming from the walls. Or through my phone. Just... about three months.
Have you had any periods around the time these voices started when your mood was unusually high or unusually low?
No. My mood is... it's just normal. I haven't been really high or low. Just... the usual.
Have you noticed your thoughts becoming hard to follow or disorganized?
No... I don't really know what you mean by that. My thoughts are... they're just my thoughts. They make sense to me. I can follow them fine.
Have you used any alcohol, cannabis, stimulants, or other drugs around the time these voices started?
No. I don't... I don't use any of that. Just... no.
Have you ever been told you have seizures?
No. I haven't.
Do you believe that anyone is trying to harm you, spy on you, or control you?
No... I don't know why someone would do that. I haven't... no, nobody is spying on me.
Have these problems with hearing voices and coping at work or home been going on for at least six months?

Yes. Longer than six months. It's... it's been building for about two years and four months. Right around the time of the company expansion... when they put me in charge of the new arts-and-commerce division.
Have you ever had trouble keeping your thoughts organized or speaking in a way that others found hard to follow?
No... I don't think so. I communicate fine. If people don't understand me, I haven't... I haven't noticed it being my fault. My thoughts are my own.
Have you noticed becoming emotionally flat or not expressing much feeling compared with before?

I don't know about flat. I just... I used to be the one driving every idea, you know? Calling people after openings. Now I just... sit at my desk for hours. Staring at the agenda. I don't really talk to my husband much, or the staff. I just don't feel much about the work anymore. Even though I used to love it.
Do you believe the people at work are actually talking about you, even when there’s no evidence they are?
No... I don't really know what they talk about. Like I said, I mostly just stay in my office. I haven't... I haven't noticed them talking about me.
Do you ever hear voices or sounds that other people around you cannot hear?

I... yes. I suppose that's... that's actually why I came in. I just keep hearing people talking. Like... through the conference room walls. Or from my phone, even when it's completely turned off. 

It's usually the board members. Or some of the staff... just saying that I'm ruining the company. It sounds so clear that I... I actually answer them back. Before I realize that no one else heard it.
Besides hearing these voices, have you noticed any other unusual sensory experiences, like seeing things others don’t see?
No... I haven't seen anything. It's just the talking.
Have you had any fixed beliefs that others would say are clearly untrue, such as being specially watched, followed, or controlled?
No... I don't think so. I haven't felt like anyone is following me or... watching me. It's really just what I told you before.
Do you believe the people at work are deliberately trying to harm, sabotage, or target you?
No... I don't think so. They aren't trying to hurt me or sabotage anything. It's just... the talking. Like I said.
When you hear these voices, do they seem like they are coming from outside your head, or from inside your own mind?

Outside. They... they come from outside. 

Like, through the conference room walls. Or from my phone, even when it's turned off. It's usually the board members... or staff. Saying I'm ruining the company. It sounds so clear that... I've actually answered them out loud. Before I realize no one else heard it.
